problem_register_binding.summary: Hosted FE 2b8318dfb / 0a753647b against BFF 9f461b17e: paging the cited evidence list reached page 5 while the pager said '第 5 頁 · 共 1754 筆' even though the BFF caps cited references at 500 (25 pages of 20), and an unnamed meeting_action_ticket row whose source_class is also meeting_action_ticket displayed '會議行動單 · 會議行動單' under its kind name.

AC1_cited_pager_browsable_and_full_count.implementation: Added citedBrowsableTotal in src/management/pages/oversight/_core.tsx and mgmt.evidence.pager.truncatedPageFmt in zh-TW ('第 {{page}} / {{pages}} 頁 · 列出 {{listed}} 筆（共 {{total}} 筆）') and en-US ('Page {{page}} of {{pages}} · {{listed}} of {{total}} listed'). When summary.references_truncated is true, EvidenceCitedList passes browsableTotal (e.g. 500) and browsablePages (e.g. 25) to EvidencePager and disables Next when currentPage >= browsablePages (page 25 of 25). When not truncated or when the new BFF fields are absent, EvidencePager renders the existing mgmt.evidence.pager.pageFmt unchanged.
tests: src/management/pages/oversight/EvidenceExplorerPage.test.tsx > Evidence page: cited list (FE-EVIDENCE-CITED-20261125) > FE-EVIDENCE-CITED-PAGER-KIND-LINE-20261127: shows browsable and full counts in the cited pager when references_truncated is true, disables Next on page 25 of 25, names a matching kind/source_class once, and stays unchanged when not truncated or when new BFF fields are absent

AC2_cited_row_kind_and_source_class_dedu.implementation: Updated EvidenceCitedList row rendering in src/management/pages/oversight/_core.tsx to compare citedKindLabel(t, row.refKind) and citedSourceClassLabel(t, row.sourceClass). When both labels are the same words (such as meeting_action_ticket / meeting_action_ticket -> '會議行動單' / 'Meeting action ticket'), the kind line renders that label once without repeating '· <sourceClassLabel>'. Rows with different kind and source class labels remain unchanged, and rows with nameMissing keep their kind as the primary name and refId as secondary monospace text.
